stage_info.name: polish
stage_info.description: Polish refinement stage: Final refinement steps with CTF refinement and motion correction to achieve best possible resolution, not recommend to use the agent run

polish.enable_ctf_refinement_description: Enable local and global CTF refinement during refinement steps

initial_refinement.refine_defocus_refine_description: Enable local CTF refinement (defocus) for initial refinement
initial_refinement.refine_ctf_global_refine_description: Enable global CTF refinement for initial refinement

final_refinement.refine_defocus_refine_description: Enable local CTF refinement (defocus) for final refinement
final_refinement.refine_ctf_global_refine_description: Enable global CTF refinement for final refinement

steps.name: verify_inputs
steps.description: Verify that optimization and preprocessing stages are complete and read required job UIDs

steps.name: initial_refinement
steps.description: Initial homogeneous refinement with CTF refinement enabled
steps.notes: Uses particles and volume from best optimization job. Enables both local and global CTF refinement.

steps.name: motion_correction
steps.description: Reference-based motion correction using reference volume
steps.notes: Uses micrographs from preprocessing, particles and volume from initial refinement. Output particles group is 'particles_0'.

steps.name: final_refinement
steps.description: Final homogeneous refinement with CTF refinement enabled
steps.notes: Uses motion-corrected particles (particles_0) from motion correction step and volume from initial refinement. This is the final best job.
